source_evidence: Alternative mutual funds (sometimes called alt funds or liquid alts) are publicly offered, SEC-registered mutual funds that hold non-traditional investments or use complex investment and trading strategies.
answer: Alternative mutual funds—also called alt funds or liquid alts—are mutual funds that differ from traditional funds by holding non-traditional investments, using more complex trading strategies, or both. Examples include investing in commodities or using short selling and derivatives. These strategies can bring additional risks and higher costs, so understand a fund’s approach and expenses before investing.
